## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

The one owner of who a customer is: the users table, credentials, sign-in
methods, lock state and the short-lived tokens that carry an in-flight social
sign-in.

`account` and `auth` both depend on this and neither depends on the other.
That is deliberate: they used to depend on each other, which meant neither
could be read or changed alone.

Authorization is decided server-side, always. A sign-in method being offered by
the front is never evidence that it is permitted; the shop gate in
`settings` is re-checked on every social sign-in and link.

<!-- invariants:end -->
